title: Cartier-preserving pullback of the canonical boundary
statement: For n>0 and finite A killed by n there is one OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] such that the canonical classes [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] satisfy the pro-etale base-change square [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] for every Cartesian square of effective Cartier immersions with n invertible on both bases. The specified counit-mate exchange is invertible.

proof.text: Pull back local regular equations and the pole extension. The pulled equations are regular by the Cartier hypothesis. The assignment t inverse↦(g*t) inverse and pullback of units glue, since changes by units are respected. The finite-stalk formula identifies the closed exchange with identity on the supported constant stalks and zero elsewhere.

proof.text: Naturality of the relative boundary and derived scalar extension proves the ordinary Ext square. One normalized roots transport works for all schemes: its root inclusion and pure tensor equations fix its components. Uniqueness of the relative boundary identifies both ordinary classes with the canonical ones.

proof.text: Comparison preserves inverse-image commutation and counits. The adjunct of closed exchange is inverse-image commutation followed by the pulled counit. Adjunction injectivity therefore identifies its comparison with the actual geoCartierExchange. Transport the ordinary square and its invertibility through the supported comparison isomorphisms. Identity and empty pullbacks give identity and zero maps respectively.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_pullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) :
    ∃ t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A n hA,
      ∀ {D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) (i' : D' ⟶ Z')
        [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i'] (g : Z' ⟶ Z) (gD : D' ⟶ D)
        (sq : IsPullback gD i' i g) (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) (hI' : i'.ker.IsInvertible)
        (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) (hZ' : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z', ⊤))),
        IsIso (geoCartierExchange A i i' g gD sq.toCommSq) ∧
        (Ext.mk₀ (geoCartierExchange A i i' g gD sq.toCommSq)).comp
            (geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i' hI' hZ') (zero_add 2) =
          ((geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i hI hZ).mapExactFunctor
            (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g)).comp
            (Ext.mk₀ (geoCartierLinePullback A n hA t g hZ).hom) (add_zero 2)
